title: Monk, which automates accounts receivable workflows, raised a $25M Series A co-led by Footwork and Acrew Capital, bringing its total funding to $29M (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Monk, which automates accounts receivable workflows, raised a $25M Series A co-led by Footwork and Acrew Capital, bringing its total funding to $29M — Monk, which automates accounts receivable workflows, raised $25 million in Series A funding led by Footwork, CEO George Kurdin tells Axios exclusively.
